method: Manual inspection of offline Blender renders from final TPAC geometry, decoded diffuse, and quantized native motion weights. Not a game render.
findings: Rest views and sampled worst native motion frames show no gross sleeve/waist/boot tears after fixes.
Head-neck collar appears continuous in all four delivered rest LOD previews; there are no identical cross-equipment vertices, so this is visual evidence rather than a welded neck assertion.
Opaque fallback hair cards are visible; low LOD hair is coarse at close range.
Fixed fingers retain open shape; weapon grip, body scaling, horse collision, cloth intersections and mixed equipment require user game tests.
Studio diffuse preview does not certify in-game PBR lighting.
